user.title: Configure COP Calculator
user.description: Set up energy monitoring for your heat pump. Select the sensors that measure electrical consumption and thermal production. The unit (kWh, Wh, MWh, kW, W, etc.) is detected automatically.

data_description.name: Display name for the heat pump device
data_description.electrical_entity: Sensor that measures the electrical energy consumption (or power) of the heat pump. The unit is detected automatically.
data_description.thermal_entity: Sensor that measures the thermal energy production (or power) of the heat pump. The unit is detected automatically.
data_description.averaging_period: Time window (in minutes) for calculating the current COP. Longer periods smooth out delays between electrical input and thermal output.

mode.title: Operating Mode (Optional)
mode.description: Optionally configure a mode sensor to track COP separately for heating, hot water (DHW), and simultaneous operation. Leave the mode sensor empty to skip.

data_description.mode_entity: Entity that indicates the current operating mode of your heat pump (e.g., an input_select or sensor)
data_description.mode_heating_states: Comma-separated state values that indicate heating mode (e.g. 'Heizen, heating')
data_description.mode_dhw_states: Comma-separated state values that indicate hot water/DHW mode (e.g. 'Warmwasser, dhw')
data_description.mode_simultaneous_states: Comma-separated state values that indicate simultaneous heating + DHW (e.g. 'Heizen+WW, simultaneous'). Leave empty if not applicable.

pricing.title: Electricity Pricing
pricing.description: Optionally configure electricity pricing to calculate costs and savings.

data_description.price_type: Choose how electricity price is determined
data_description.electricity_price: Fixed price per kWh in EUR (e.g. 0.30)
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Sensor providing dynamic electricity price (e.g. from Tibber or aWATTar)

error.same_entity: Electrical and thermal sensors must be different entities
error.no_heating_states: Please enter at least one heating mode state value
error.no_dhw_states: Please enter at least one hot water mode state value
